message.content: {"hts_code": "6401.99.6090", "reason": "The boot's outer sole is mostly obscured by leather flocking and the upper is predominantly rubber/plastic, so under the Chapter 64 footwear rules the outer surface determined by the 'external surface area' test is rubber/plastic, but the leather-flocked sole is the surface contacting the ground and the upper is mostly rubber, placing it in heading 6401 as waterproof footwear with outer soles and uppers of rubber or plastics, not covering the ankle-protective 'over the ankle' category of 6401.99 only if it fails the ankle test; as an above-the-ankle waterproof boot with rubber/plastic uppers, the applicable subheading is 6401.99 with the men's rubber/plastic boot statistical suffix."}

predicted_reason: The boot's outer sole is mostly obscured by leather flocking and the upper is predominantly rubber/plastic, so under the Chapter 64 footwear rules the outer surface determined by the 'external surface area' test is rubber/plastic, but the leather-flocked sole is the surface contacting the ground and the upper is mostly rubber, placing it in heading 6401 as waterproof footwear with outer soles and uppers of rubber or plastics, not covering the ankle-protective 'over the ankle' category of 6401.99 only if it fails the ankle test; as an above-the-ankle waterproof boot with rubber/plastic uppers, the applicable subheading is 6401.99 with the men's rubber/plastic boot statistical suffix.
